future_acceptance_obligations.requirement: Preserve the exact source version and publication grain; retrieval is not publication.
The qualification test population is one disclosed sample/test set, not all products or customers.
Unidentified parameters/customer remain unidentified; no adjacent-link name inference.
Keep internal and customer observations as attributed evidence; no averaged pass rate.
A near-threshold measurement is not a near-certain commercial outcome.
The commercial-sales window remains conditional and forward-looking.
An announced nonbinding MOU is distinct from a binding purchase agreement.
Applications mentioned as opportunities are not customer orders or market share.
The later MOU does not supersede the older qualification proposition.
Repeated issuer statements are not independent confirmations.
The Antamina agreement counter is tranche-specific, not whole-company ounces.
Do not apply the payable factor again to already-payable input.
Do not multiply the initial stream share by BHP’s share a second time.
Use a phase-specific scenario only with a known or explicitly assumed phase.
A modeled threshold crossing is piecewise; do not use one rate for the whole period.
Upfront investment and ongoing payments remain separate; unit contribution is not investment return.
Life-of-mine participation is not an infinite-duration annuity.
A stream is not physical mine ownership or additional material supply.
Source-local entity descriptions do not allocate issuer/security identities.
Corporate-page sources do not inherit SEC policy from issuer identifiers.
Actual current rights and retained-source review remain required; worksheet fields grant nothing.
The existing five-source/four-company proof set cannot shrink to the easiest identities.
Research arithmetic and scenario conventions are not an audited contract interpretation or forecast.
Unknown values remain null, not false evidence or zero exposure.
